title: C gateway DIO advertises dio_int_min=4 (16ms) while runtime Trickle runs 4000ms; RFC 6550 6.7.6 wants log2(ms)
description: Found by reviewer pass 1 on b7z9.192 (pre-existing, outside that diff). lichen/apps/gateway/src/rpl_root.c:161 computes dcfg.dio_int_min = CONFIG_LICHEN_RPL_TRICKLE_IMIN_MS / 1000; Kconfig default is 4000 (lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/Kconfig:78-81, no app override), yielding dio_int_min=4. Per RFC 6550 6.7.6 the DODAG Configuration dio_int_min field is log2 of Imin in milliseconds, so the C gateway advertises a 16ms Trickle Imin on the wire while its own Trickle runs at 4000ms; Rust and Python advertise 12 (4096ms, matching lichen_rpl_dodag_config_init defaults). Fix: convert ms to log2 (or set the option field from a log2 constant) so the advertised value matches the runtime timer and the other stacks. Verify with the RPL vector/parity tests. Evidence gathered 2026-09-10 by worker-5 during b7z9.192 review.
